- Grams = 300 ml x 1.0 g/ml (meat) = about 300 g. Cross-check: a fill of roughly 0.1 of capacity is consistent with a few hundred grams of cooked chicken.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: no base layer is visible; the bowl floor is bare steel, so no hidden base.
